meta.name: Matron UI redesign
meta.derivation: Colour tokens and font shorthands are PARSED from the rendering artifact, not hand-written. Regenerate after any change rather than editing this file. States, breakpoints, layering and intent (below) are hand-authored — they cannot be probed from a static render.
meta.rootFontSize: html font-size is calc(16px - 1px) = 15px in matron-web; every value here is absolute px, so it is unaffected

probing.staticStates: static/index.json — 28 runtime-free files with self-hosted fonts (8 cover the round-2 surfaces)
probing.snippet: [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-spec]')].map(el => ({ name: el.dataset.spec, target: el.dataset.target, cs: getComputedStyle(el) }))
probing.devtool: data-spec values starting 'devtool.' and 'gallery' are handoff affordances — do not implement
probing.granularity: Tagged at the same granularity as component-map.json's selectors; multi-rung components are split so a diff never compares a container against a child.

deliverables.Matron Redesign.dc.html: editable source of truth (interactive; carries the tokens inline)
deliverables.design-tokens.json / .css: tokens, type roles, states, breakpoints, layering, content types, copy
deliverables.component-map.json: data-spec → src/journal selector, with implemented/new/devtool status
deliverables.CHANGELOG-vs-current.md: what already landed at tree eb6e7d6f vs what has not

surfaceLadder.intent: Dark is a lightness ladder, not an inverted light theme.

roles.--m-paper: message canvas reading surface (recedes behind chrome)
roles.--m-panel: sidebar, header, composer, cards — raised chrome
roles.--m-raised: inset areas inside cards: tool output, diff body, upload preview

mapToRepoTokens.note: Suggested mapping onto the existing --cpd-* names in src/journal/shell.pcss

theming.persistence: localStorage 'matron-redesign-theme'; falls back to prefers-color-scheme on first load

title.sm.use: message author name, unread session name, modal filename

label.xs.use: sidebar tabs, compact button, diff open-file link

body.md.use: message prose, own-message bubbles, composer input

meta.md.use: session preview, subagent pill, slash summary, footer email

mono.usage.use: usage meter labels + percentages (500 + ink for the ctx row)

mono.micro.use: slash arg hints, code block filename, queue counter chip, popover figures

mono.code.use: code block body, diff rows, tool output

mono.command.use: tool card command, slash trigger, mini ctx readout

type.minimumSize: 10px, used only for the bubble timestamp and unread numeral; body copy never below 12px

space.note: 7px and 9px appear inside dense control rows (usage meter gap, card header gap); everything structural uses even steps.

regions.sidebar.row: 9px 10px (subagent child rows 9px 10px 9px 26px), glyph gap 10px, title/preview gap 2px
regions.canvas.agentBlock: padding-left 32px (24px avatar + 8px gap), gap 8px between elements, 16px above a new agent group

bubble.rule: Consecutive own-messages tighten inner corners to 4px; the group's last bubble carries the tail.

transitions.primary buttons: filter: brightness(1.08) on hover, no transform

keyframes.m-pulse: 1.2s ease-in-out infinite, opacity .35 -> 1 — typing dots, live session dot (1.6s), recording dot (1.1s)
keyframes.m-wave: 0.9s ease-in-out infinite, scaleY .3 -> 1 — 12 recording bars, staggered 0.12s

motion.principle: No entrance animation anywhere. Motion is reserved for state that is genuinely live.

states.note: The part a screenshot cannot show.

button.primary.disabled: opacity .45 (send button when the composer is empty), pointer-events kept

button.ghostDanger.hover: background --m-hover, colour --m-crit — Deny, Cancel all, discard recording

sidebar.row.selected: background --m-selected + 3px --m-accent bar pinned left, inset 8px top/bottom, radius 999px
sidebar.row.unread: title weight 600 + teal count badge, or an 8px teal dot when there is no count

slashPalette.row.keyboardHighlight: background --m-hover (same treatment — mouse and keyboard highlight are one state)

resizeHandle.dragging: pointer capture on window, width clamped 240–420

focusVisible.resolved: 2px solid var(--m-accent), outline-offset 2px (1px on small inline controls) — matches the convention already in journal.pcss
focusVisible.exception: .mj_UploadConfirm_caption focuses NEUTRAL (border → --m-line2 darkened, no outline): the dialog autofocuses it, so an accent ring would make every upload read as active

disabled.sendButton: opacity .45 while the composer is empty — still focusable

states.reducedMotion: m-pulse / m-spin / m-wave must join the existing prefers-reduced-motion block in journal.pcss: dots and bars hold at full opacity, spinners fall back to a static ring.

breakpoints.principle: The header adapts to the CHAT PANE width via ResizeObserver, not the viewport. This is what makes half- and quarter-screen desktop windows work; a viewport media query would be wrong here.
breakpoints.chatPane < 760: usage collapses to the ctx bar alone; hover reveals a 250px popover with all four meters + reset times
breakpoints.chatPane >= 560: header subtitle shows model · workdir · status; Compact button visible
breakpoints.chatPane < 560: subtitle collapses to status dot + short model name; hovering the title block reveals a popover with full title, model, workdir, status; Compact button hidden
breakpoints.viewport <= 700 (matchMedia): single column — sidebar and chat swap via state.screen ('list' | 'chat'); back chevron appears in the header; sidebar takes 100% width
breakpoints.truncationRule: Every truncating element uses overflow:hidden + text-overflow:ellipsis + white-space:nowrap AND must expose its full value on hover — native title for single fields, a designed popover wherever more than one field collapses at once.

layering.1: sticky in-flow chrome (header, composer) — no explicit z-index, source order
layering.20: slash palette (above the composer, below modals)
layering.scrim: rgb(18 16 14 / 55%) in both themes; click-outside cancels

usageMeter.layout: 2×2 grid, 300px, column-gap 16px, row-gap 4px; ctx first and emphasised (mono.usage at weight 500 + --m-ink), others 400 + --m-ink2
usageMeter.row: grid 24px 1fr 32px, gap 7px — label right-aligned / track / percentage

labelMap.rule: Fixed short labels, applied client-side. The bridge sends long labels ('Session', 'Week (all models)', 'Week (Sonnet 5)') which truncate in a 24px column.
labelMap.fallback: unknown labels fall through to usageBarLabel() in status.ts so a new limit still renders
labelMap.missingMeter: omit the bar entirely — never render an empty track (the fable limit is absent from today's payload)

sessionRow.statusColumn: fixed 8px: running = pulsing teal dot; idle = --m-line2 dot; pinned = 13px pin --m-ink3; favourite = 13px star --m-amber; subagent = 12px spinner + 26px text indent

diffCard.rows: padding 2px 12px, white-space pre; added --m-diff-add, removed --m-diff-del + --m-crit, hunk --m-ink3
diffCard.codeTheme: code follows the UI theme — no fixed-dark code surface

permissionCard.resolved: buttons replaced by one label.sm line in --m-ink2

composer.textarea: rows = clamp(1..6) of newline count, max-height 160px then scrolls
composer.buttons: attach, mic, send (32×32; send radius 9px, filled)
composer.hints: '/ commands', 'shift+enter for newline', right-aligned live 'ctx N% · auto-idle in Nm'
composer.keyboard: Enter sends; Shift+Enter newline; palette open → ↑/↓ move highlight, Enter/Tab complete, Esc clears

slashPalette.row: grid auto auto minmax(0,1fr), baseline, gap 9px, padding 7px 12px

voiceRecording.bar: replaces the input row; 1px solid rgb(13 148 136 / 30%), min-height 44px
voiceRecording.parts: 9px red pulsing dot, mono m:ss timer, 12-bar waveform (3px bars, staggered), 'transcribing on stop', discard, stop
voiceRecording.onStop: transcript lands in the composer as editable text — never auto-sends

uploadModal.card: min(440px, 94vw), max-height 88vh, three-part flex (fixed header / scrolling body / fixed footer)
uploadModal.queue: header chip 'n of N', thumbnail strip (34px, active = 2px --m-accent ring, inactive = 1px --m-line2 on --m-raised), Skip advances without posting, Send posts and advances, modal closes only after the last file
uploadModal.perFile: caption clears between files; the posted chip carries that file's real name and size

contentTypes.source: src/journal/components.tsx → EventContent switch (exhaustive at tree eb6e7d6f)

text.spec: prose 400 14px/22px, max-width 680px; inline code, accent links, 20px list indent

prompt.label: Question
prompt.spec: neutral --m-line2 border; option buttons are all secondary; free-text row when allows_free_text or no options; Send disabled until non-empty

permission_request.label: Permission needed
permission_request.spec: border rgb(13 148 136 / 25%), accent label, exactly one filled affirmative (Allow), Always allow secondary, Deny ghost-danger

prompt_reply.spec: single resolved line, green check + 500 12.5px/16px --m-ink2; never keeps the buttons

tool_output.spec: collapsible; header = chevron + mono command + exit badge + duration; body on --m-raised, max-height 280px, scrolls

diff.spec: header = chevron, file icon, mono filename, +n green, −n critical, 'Open file ↗'; rows padding 2px 12px, white-space pre; added/removed tinted; code follows the theme

image.spec: max-width 420px, radius 10px, image edge-to-edge, figcaption inside the card on --m-panel, never overlaid; .mj_MediaLoading while fetching

file.spec: download row: 15px accent icon, 500 13px/17px name (ellipsis), mono size right; caption under in --m-ink2; button.mj_File[disabled] + spinner while preparing

unknown.spec: dashed --m-line2 on --m-raised, collapsed, JSON payload on expand — diagnostic, never hidden

attachmentChip.spec: own-side, grid 1fr auto, self bubble surface

states.error: critical border, error line, Retry + Cancel (600 12px/16px, 28px tall)

emptyStates.noneEver: Your agent conversations will appear here.
emptyStates.noArchivedMatch: No archived conversations match your search.

formats.timestamp: HH:mm 24h; sidebar rows switch to weekday then date beyond a week
formats.subtitle: model · workdir · run-state (short model name when the pane is under 560px)

decisionsResolved.usageThresholds: flat, percentage-based, identical for every meter (<50 green / 50–84 amber / ≥85 red). NOT per-meter, NOT timeframe-aware.
decisionsResolved.sessionOrdering: pinned first, then running-first within each group
decisionsResolved.subagentSurfaces: keep both the sidebar rows and the header pills
decisionsResolved.micPosition: right of the textarea, left of send

nativeChrome.why: A theme is not done when only the custom elements are themed. Each of these was an observed parity failure in the live app.
nativeChrome.scrollbars: scrollbar-width:thin + scrollbar-color:var(--m-scrollbar) transparent, plus ::-webkit-scrollbar (10px), -thumb (var(--m-scrollbar), 3px transparent border, background-clip:content-box, radius 99px), -thumb:hover (--m-scrollbar-hover), -track and -corner transparent.
nativeChrome.focusVisible: A GLOBAL `:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--m-accent); outline-offset:2px }` is the floor. Inside menus the offset is -2px so the ring insets. Never browser-blue.
nativeChrome.nativeInputs: Every input/textarea/select sets background, color AND border explicitly — an unstyled input inherits UA white, which is the white-on-dark 'Agent default' field. Placeholder colour set to --m-ink3.
nativeChrome.disabledFields: --m-subtle fill + --m-ink3 text. Never opacity alone: opacity on a UA-white field is still white.

invariants.reference: GENERATIVE-SYSTEM.md §10 — full prose. Summarised here for machine consumption.

contentWidth.rule: one measure per region; overflow scrolls inside the element, the measure never bends

alignmentGrid.outerEdge: card padding-left — every direct child starts here
alignmentGrid.innerEdge: outer + 24px — the text column of a fixed 24px icon gutter; icon-prefixed lines and their lists share it
alignmentGrid.rightEdge: card padding-right — timestamps/counts/sizes across ALL message types share one vertical line
alignmentGrid.prohibited: inline emoji as icons: glyph width makes the left edge variable, so no two rows align. Icons are SVG in the gutter.

spacingRhythm.rule: one gap value per container, set on flex/grid gap — never per-child margins. A label is bound to the field BELOW it. A card must not change rhythm between states.

invariants.onePrimary: Exactly one filled accent button per surface, on the affirmative (Send now / Start session / Send / Allow). Everything else is secondary or ghost. Destructive is ghost, critical on hover only.

anchors.sidebarRow: right-click context menu ONLY — no persistent ⋯ affordance (operator decision)

menus.internals: rows grid 16px 1fr, gap 10, padding 7/9, radius 7 inside a 4px-padded shell so hover insets from the shell edge; groups separated by a hairline, not a gap
